gen-dafont-nordic-gf-karla: Powerful and ancient, Nordic has tight, pinched openings and wide-spaced letters. Big and short is where the heading earns its keep, while Karla, a stocky sans with a gaping c, takes the rest.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-mada: Far-apart brush dabs and tightly pinched openings make Nordic look ancient and powerful. Mada, a sans-serif with curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, gives that heft room to breathe.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans lets every curve open wide, with a high mean line running through each word. But Nordic is the one with muscle, its pinched, ancient letters made for display while the sans does the reading.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-maven-pro: Nordic spaces its letters like brush dabs set far apart, each opening pinched shut like a folded leaf. Maven Pro, a modern sans with a welcoming gap in the c, does the reading while Nordic does the showing.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-michroma: Nordic is powerful and ancient, its pinched letters spaced like brush dabs far apart. Michroma, a sans with wide berths either side of each letter, would read spacious and steady over many lines.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable and modern, Miriam Libre is wiry, with open bends in its s. Nordic's pinched, brush-dab letters bring the weight up top, and the cast-iron-tall lowercase keeps long text moving.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-mozilla-headline: Tight, pinched and ancient, Nordic keeps each stroke at a single constant width. Mozilla Headline brings friendly, big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, loosening everything Nordic squeezes shut.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-nobile: Nordic is powerful and ancient, with tight, pinched openings. Nobile, with open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs and caps barely above lowercase, keeps things contemporary and level beside it.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-nokora: Nokora reads clean and approachable, with an s that never tightens. Its thick, dark stripe of lowercase gives Nordic's wire-weight, far-spaced letters something solid to lean on through each line.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Ancient, Nordic pinches its counters shut behind strokes of one constant width. Noto Kufi Arabic, a modern sans-serif with an open gap in the c, loosens everything around it.
